notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0007] Money operations need idempotency_key support: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None`; check `ledgerly.audit.events()` for a matching key first and return the original result without reapplying, and include the key in the audit entry (INC-204).
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary values with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0002] Use to_money and ZERO from money module: Convert line amounts with ledgerly.money.to_money and accumulate Decimal sums starting from ledgerly.money.ZERO, as done in invoice_total and line_total in ledgerly/invoice.py.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Signal domain failures by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors with stable snake_case codes such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount", matching the codes used in ledgerly.invoice.issue_invoice.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 1 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0004] Exclude bool when validating integer inputs: When validating an int parameter, reject bool explicitly (isinstance(x, bool)) before the int check, since True/False are ints in Python and would otherwise pass quantity validation.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize any incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

candidate.content: Reject operations on models in the wrong status by raising `BillingError("invalid_state", f"<entity> {id} is {status}")`, as `authorize` does for invoices.

item.title: Record state changes in audit log
item.content: Every payment state transition must call `ledgerly.audit.record` with a snake_case event name and the payment id/amount, mirroring `payment_authorized`.
